items.title: Cousins scores late to lift Senators
items.summary: Nick Cousins tipped a Thomas Chabot shot with 2:18 left and Shane Pinto added an empty-net goal. Samuel Ersson made 30 saves and Ottawa is 11-6-1.

items.title: Ullmark close, Greig day to day
items.summary: Linus Ullmark practiced fully Friday after missing seven games with a lower-body strain. Ridly Greig missed a second straight game and is day to day.

items.title: Ersson gets another start
items.summary: Travis Green started Ersson again, who is 2-0-1 since Oct 21. Philip Tomasino has a point in each of his first three games with Ottawa.

items.title: Senators injury list
items.summary: Warren Foegele, William Eklund (ankle), Andre Burakovsky and Kurtis MacDermid are out. Tyler Kleven returned to practice after an illness.

PHI.headline: The Flyers (4-10-4) open a back-to-back in Calgary after a 3-2 loss to the Rangers, their fifth loss in six games.
PHI.game: Next: Sun Nov 08, 7:00 PM ET at Calgary, Scotiabank Saddledome (NBCSP, SNW). Expected starter: Dan Vladar (projected).

items.title: Canucks bring 5-game losing streak into matchup against the Flyers
items.summary: Philadelphia Flyers (4-10-5, in the Metropolitan Division) vs. Vancouver Canucks (3-15-1, in the Pacific Division)

items.title: Matt Coronato scores at 4:08 of overtime in Flames' 4-3 victory over Flyers
items.summary: — Matt Coronato scored at 4:08 of overtime to give the Calgary Flames a 4-3 victory over the Philadelphia Flyers on Sunday night.

items.title: Flyers at Flames projected lineups
items.summary: Michael Bunting and David Jiricek are projected scratches. Rasmus Ristolainen will miss a sixth straight game and the Flyers did not hold a morning skate.

items.title: Flames Game Day: a Sunday visit from the Flyers
items.summary: Dan Vladar is projected to start against Calgary, with Joseph Woll as backup.

items.title: RAV4 Things: Flyers @ Flames
items.summary: Saturday practice reunited Matvei Michkov and Porter Martone with Noah Cates. Michkov leads the team with 10 goals.

items.title: Flyers blow third-period lead in 3-2 loss to Rangers
items.summary: The Rangers scored twice in 89 seconds in the third period after the Flyers led 2-1. Rick Tocchet called the collapse inexcusable.

PIT.headline: The Penguins (6-9-2) play at Anaheim on the second night of a back-to-back after a 5-2 win in Los Angeles ended a four-game skid.
PIT.game: Next: Sun Nov 08, 8:00 PM ET at Anaheim, Honda Center (Prime Video, SN, SN-PIT). Expected starter: Arturs Silovs.

items.title: Cutter Gauthier gets his 3rd hat trick in November, propelling the prolific Ducks past Penguins 5-2
items.summary: — Cutter Gauthier continued his scoring rampage with his third hat trick in eight days, and captain Mikael Granlund had a goal and three assists in the Anaheim Ducks' fifth consecutive victory, 5-2 over the Pittsburgh Penguins on Sunday night.

items.title: Penguins at Ducks projected lineups
items.summary: Arturs Silovs is expected to start. Andrei Kuzmenko and Ilya Solovyov are projected scratches, and neither team held a morning skate.

items.title: Penguins Game 18: lines, notes and how to watch vs. Ducks
items.summary: Silovs is almost certain to start the back-to-back. The lines are unchanged from Saturday.

items.title: Cutter Gauthier, Ducks out to put freeze on Penguins' western swing
items.summary: Pittsburgh had lost eight of 10 before Saturday. Tommy Novak has four goals in his past four games.

items.title: Crosby, Novak each score twice, Penguins defeat Kings
items.summary: Sergei Murashov made 26 saves for his first win of the season. Crosby moved into sixth place on the NHL's all-time points list.

items.title: Penguins play the Ducks after Novak's 2-goal game
items.summary: Pittsburgh Penguins (6-9-2, in the Metropolitan Division) vs. Anaheim Ducks (9-7-1, in the Pacific Division)

items.title: Sidney Crosby takes sole possession of 6th on NHL scoring list in Penguins' 5-2 win over Kings
items.summary: — Sidney Crosby scored two goals while moving into sole possession of sixth place on the NHL’s career scoring list, and the Pittsburgh Penguins snapped their four-game skid with a 5-2 victory over the Los Angeles Kings on Saturday night.

SEA.headline: The Kraken lost 4-3 to the Rangers at home on Saturday after a late comeback fell short.
SEA.game: Next: Thu Nov 12, 12:00 PM ET vs Carolina Hurricanes, Veikkaus Arena in Helsinki (CARNHL, HHN, KONG, NHLN, Prime Video, SN+, TVAS). Starter not announced.

items.title: Korpisalo makes 25 saves in debut for Rangers, who hold off Kraken
items.summary: Seattle fell behind 4-0 before goals by Kaapo Kakko, Jordan Eberle and Vince Dunn in the third period. Joey Daccord was pulled after allowing three goals on 10 shots and Philipp Grubauer made 15 saves in relief.

items.title: Late Kraken rally comes up short in 4-3 loss to Rangers
items.summary: Berkly Catton had two assists and extended his point streak to eight games. The Kraken next travel to Helsinki for two games against Carolina in the NHL Global Series.

items.title: Rangers at Kraken projected lineups
items.summary: Jagger Firkus was recalled from Coachella Valley but was not expected to play. Jacob Melanson, Ryan Lindgren, Jared McCann and Curtis Douglas were listed as injured.

items.title: Wright traded to Predators by Kraken
items.summary: Seattle traded center Shane Wright to Nashville for forward Matthew Wood on Nov. 1. Wood had three points in 14 games with Nashville this season.

SJS.headline: The Sharks lost 4-3 in Dallas for their fifth straight loss and return home to face the Islanders.
SJS.game: Next: Mon Nov 09, 10:00 PM ET vs NYI, SAP Center at San Jose (NBCSCA, MSGSN). Starter not announced.

items.title: New York brings losing streak into matchup with San Jose
items.summary: New York Islanders (7-6-3, in the Metropolitan Division) vs. San Jose Sharks (7-11-1, in the Pacific Division)

items.title: Stars hand Sharks fifth straight loss
items.summary: Michael Misa, Ivar Stenberg and Will Smith scored and Macklin Celebrini had three assists. Dallas scored three power-play goals.

items.title: Pohlkamp gets first NHL point
items.summary: Eric Pohlkamp had an assist for his first NHL point. Alex Nedeljkovic made 26 saves.

items.title: Hajek sent back to AHL
items.summary: Libor Hajek was assigned to the Barracuda without playing. Wennberg and Chernyshov went on IR on Oct. 28.

items.title: Sharks recall Eric Pohlkamp
items.summary: The Sharks recalled defenseman Eric Pohlkamp from the Barracuda for the first time. He had seven assists in 10 AHL games.

STL.headline: The Blues lost 3-1 at Nashville on Saturday for their third straight loss.
STL.game: Next: Tue Nov 10, 8:00 PM ET vs Detroit Red Wings, Enterprise Center (HBO MAX, SN+, TNT). Starter not announced.

items.title: Blues bring 3-game losing streak into matchup against the Red Wings
items.summary: Detroit Red Wings (7-8-3, in the Atlantic Division) vs. St. Louis Blues (7-8-2, in the Central Division)

items.title: Stamkos, Josi lift Predators past Blues for fourth straight win
items.summary: Jimmy Snuggerud scored on the power play and Joel Hofer made 26 saves in a 3-1 loss. Coach Jim Montgomery said, "We need to be better."

items.title: Blues at Predators projected lineups
items.summary: The Blues were expected to use the same lineup as their 5-4 overtime loss at New Jersey. Logan Mailloux was recalled from a conditioning assignment with Springfield but stays on injured reserve.

items.title: Blues line combinations
items.summary: Daily Faceoff lists Tyler Tucker and Dillon Dube on injured reserve and Mason McTavish as day-to-day while still in the lineup.

TBL.headline: The Lightning beat Minnesota 4-3 in overtime on Saturday and play at Winnipeg on Sunday on the back end of a back-to-back.
TBL.game: Next: Sun Nov 08, 6:00 PM ET at WPG, Canada Life Centre (TSN3, The Spot). Andrei Vasilevskiy projected to start.

items.title: Scheifele scores on power play with 1.6 seconds left to lift Jets past Lightning, 4-3
items.summary: — Mark Scheifele scored on a 5-on-3 power play with 1.6 seconds left and the Winnipeg Jets beat the Tampa Bay Lightning 4-3 on Sunday after blowing a late three-goal lead.

items.title: Vasilevskiy projected at Winnipeg
items.summary: Paul Edmonds projected Andrei Vasilevskiy to start with Dennis Hildeby as backup. Jake Guentzel leads the team with 10 goals.

items.title: Kucherov wins it in OT at Minnesota
items.summary: Nikita Kucherov scored on the power play in overtime for a 4-3 win. Jake Guentzel scored twice and Dennis Hildeby made 19 saves.

items.title: Point streak reaches six games
items.summary: Tampa Bay improved to 11-3-2 with its third straight win. It is 4-0-2 in its last six.

items.title: Tampa Bay visits Winnipeg after shootout victory
items.summary: Tampa Bay Lightning (11-3-2, in the Atlantic Division) vs. Winnipeg Jets (6-8-3, in the Central Division)

items.title: Nikita Kucherov scores power-play goal in overtime and Lightning rally for 4-3 win over Wild
items.summary: — Nikita Kucherov scored a power-play goal 3:23 into overtime and the Tampa Bay Lightning rallied past the Minnesota Wild 4-3 on Saturday night.

items.title: Gourde out until December
items.summary: Yanni Gourde is recovering from offseason hip surgery. Dominic James broke his hand in training.

UTA.headline: The Mammoth lost 4-2 in Ottawa on Saturday to finish a five-game road trip 2-2-1.
UTA.game: Next: Wed Nov 11, 9:30 PM ET at Vegas Golden Knights, T-Mobile Arena (HBO MAX, TNT, truTV). Starter not announced.

items.title: Utah falls to Ottawa in close game
items.summary: Clayton Keller and Barrett Hayton scored, but Ottawa scored twice in the final three minutes. Karel Vejmelka made 17 saves.

items.title: Tourigny says blue line is banged up
items.summary: It was Utah's first set of back-to-back losses this season. Andre Tourigny said fatigue played a role and the defense needs to get healthy.

items.title: Schmidt out day to day
items.summary: Nate Schmidt missed Saturday's game with an upper-body injury. Utah recalled Gregor Biber, but Artyom Duda played instead.

items.title: Mammoth injury list
items.summary: Kailer Yamamoto is on IR retroactive to Oct 29 and Maveric Lamoureux is out with a shoulder injury. Biber and Ben McCartney were scratched.

items.title: Carcone activated, Marino to IR
items.summary: Michael Carcone returned from an upper-body injury. John Marino went on IR retroactive to Oct 17.

VAN.headline: The Canucks lost 4-2 in Edmonton on Saturday for their fifth straight loss and are 3-15-1.
VAN.game: Next: Mon Nov 9, 9:30 PM ET vs Philadelphia, Rogers Arena (NBCSP, SN+). Starter not announced.

items.summary: Philadelphia Flyers (4-10-5, in the Metropolitan Division) vs. Vancouver Canucks (3-15-1, in the Pacific Division)

items.title: Canucks losses keep piling up
items.summary: Malhotra scratched Quillan, put Bains on the top line with Pettersson and Boeser, and played Schenn for Mancini. Willander missed a third straight game.

items.title: Draisaitl scores twice, Oilers hold off Canucks
items.summary: Max Sasson and Brock Boeser scored and Leevi Merilainen made 26 saves. Boeser briefly left in the second period after blocking a shot off his foot but returned.

items.title: Draisaitl scores twice, McDavid has 3 assists to extend streak and Oilers beat skidding Canucks 4-2
items.summary: — Leon Draisaitl had two goals and an assist, Connor McDavid added three more assists and the Edmonton Oilers beat the struggling Vancouver Canucks 4-2 on Saturday night.

items.title: Oilers beat skidding Canucks 4-2
items.summary: Vancouver is 1-14-1 since a 2-1 start. The Canucks host Philadelphia on Monday.

items.title: Canucks at Oilers projected lineups
items.summary: Chytil (upper body) and Demko (hip) were listed as injured. Bains was expected in for Quillan and Schenn for Mancini.

VGK.headline: In progress at 5 PM ET: Vegas led Buffalo 1-0 on a Mitch Marner goal. The Golden Knights finish a road trip at Buffalo on Sunday after a 2-1 win at Detroit on Thursday.
VGK.game: Next: Sun Nov 08, 3:30 PM ET at BUF, KeyBank Center (MSG-B, SCRIPPS, SN1, TVAS). Carter Hart projected to start.

items.title: Hart projected to start at Buffalo
items.summary: The Hockey News projected Carter Hart (5-3-2, .900) in goal with lines unchanged. Vegas is 5-2-2 on the road.

items.title: Connelly scores in three straight
items.summary: Trevor Connelly has seven goals and has scored in three straight games. Jack Eichel leads the team with 23 points.

items.title: Olofsson back in 2-1 win at Detroit
items.summary: Victor Olofsson returned from injury on Nov. 5. Braeden Bowman scored in the win.

items.title: Tomas Hertl scores twice as Golden Knights beat Sabres 4-1 for third straight win
items.summary: — Tomas Hertl scored two goals and the Vegas Golden Knights won their third straight game, 4-1 over the Buffalo Sabres on Sunday.

WPG.headline: The Jets host Tampa Bay on Sunday after a 6-2 win over Vancouver on Thursday.
WPG.game: Next: Sun Nov 08, 6:00 PM ET vs TBL, Canada Life Centre (TSN3, The Spot). Stuart Skinner projected to start.

items.title: Jets disappointed ex-goalie Connor Hellebuyck sitting out
items.summary: The Jets are disappointed they won't get closure for the departure of ex-goalie Connor Hellebuyck as he won't be starting for the Devils when they play in Winnipeg on Tuesday.

items.title: Devils visit the Jets after Meier's 2-goal game
items.summary: New Jersey Devils (13-5, in the Metropolitan Division) vs. Winnipeg Jets (7-8-3, in the Central Division)

items.title: Connor Hellebuyck won't play in return to Winnipeg with Devils
items.summary: The Devils announced Connor Hellebuyck will not face the Jets on Tuesday night in his first trip to Winnipeg since his contentious trade demand was granted.

items.title: Scheifele scores on power play with 1.6 seconds left to lift Jets past Lightning, 4-3
items.summary: — Mark Scheifele scored on a 5-on-3 power play with 1.6 seconds left and the Winnipeg Jets beat the Tampa Bay Lightning 4-3 on Sunday after blowing a late three-goal lead.

items.title: Skinner projected against Lightning
items.summary: Paul Edmonds projected Stuart Skinner to start with lines unchanged. Kyle Connor leads the Jets with 13 goals and 19 points.

items.title: Scheifele near franchise records
items.summary: Mark Scheifele is four goals and six points from Dale Hawerchuk's franchise marks. Dylan DeMelo has played 292 straight regular-season games.

items.summary: Tampa Bay Lightning (11-3-2, in the Atlantic Division) vs. Winnipeg Jets (6-8-3, in the Central Division)

items.title: Morrissey sheds non-contact sweater
items.summary: Josh Morrissey practiced in a regular sweater on Nov. 7. He has been out since a wrist injury on Oct. 7.

WSH.headline: The Capitals beat Florida 4-3 at home on Saturday to end a two-game losing streak.
WSH.game: Next: Tue Nov 10, 7:00 PM ET at Ottawa Senators, Canadian Tire Centre (MNMT, RDS2, TSN5). Starter not announced.

items.title: Senators and Capitals face off in Eastern Conference action
items.summary: Washington Capitals (9-6, in the Metropolitan Division) vs. Ottawa Senators (11-6-1, in the Atlantic Division)

items.title: Capitals rally with three straight, hold off Panthers
items.summary: Jack St. Ivany scored his first NHL goal and Alex Tuch, Aliaksei Protas and Pierre-Luc Dubois also scored in a 4-3 win. Logan Thompson made 27 saves and Tom Wilson got a boarding major and game misconduct for a hit on Sandis Vilmanis.

items.title: Capitals line combinations
items.summary: Daily Faceoff lists Rasmus Sandin out and Vincent Desharnais on injured reserve, with Thompson and Charlie Lindgren in goal.

items.title: Panthers at Capitals projected lineups
items.summary: Ethen Frank, Ivan Miroshnichenko and Remi Poirier were listed as scratches. Martin Fehervary took a maintenance day Thursday but was set to play.

items.title: Capitals Week Ahead: defensive absences, Thompson returns
items.summary: Desharnais is out about four to six weeks after abdominal surgery and Sandin is on LTIR with a knee injury. Thompson returned from a lower-body injury against Philadelphia.
